title: AV node ablation
description: AV node ablation treats certain types of irregular heartbeat (arrhythmias) by carefully destroying the abnormal electrical tissue causing the problem. This procedure is performed using a catheter-based approach guided by specialized imaging, allowing your cardiologist to target only the problematic tissue while preserving normal heart function. The procedure is minimally invasive, typically requiring only a small catheter inserted through the groin or arm. Most patients experience dramatic improvement in symptoms and can return to normal activities quickly.
